description: This file defines the 'EcuStimulatorSandbox' class which extends 'FrameHelper'. It serves as a test or sandbox utility to run and display the ECU stimulator panel by creating an instance of itself and invoking the 'showFrame' method with the panel retrieved from 'EcuStimulator'.

classes.name: EcuStimulatorSandbox
classes.description: A class extending FrameHelper to facilitate displaying the ECU Stimulator panel for testing or sandbox purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application that initializes and shows the ECU Stimulator panel in a frame.
